llm_response.reason: The website exhibits several scam characteristics: mimicking the design and branding of a reputable marketplace (Lazada), listing deep discounts (up to 95%), embedding references to gambling and bonuses, ambiguous or spoofed company information, and offering a wide array of often-unrelated products. There is no external evidence of legitimacy or association with Lazada, and the overwhelming psychological tactics (limited time, urgent bonus offers) further suggest fraud. This combination clearly fits the profile of a fake online shopping scam website, possibly also targeting gambling addiction.
